protocol.name: meter-first full-store rho, 1024 workers, depth 6, 128-bit radix store, six-limb key formation

budget.rule: W_total is TOTAL WORK.  (a) EVERY executed step is charged at the SINGLE frequency-independent price max(MUL span, SQR span) = 47924 Ir -- the guard-squaring substitution is DELETED, so no cheaper step is ever assumed.  (b) The launch rule executes S steps at a per-trail cap L = 65536, so the number of trail starts is ceil(S/L) = 1461847968611600655368414726242031: a trail of length AT MOST L forces AT LEAST S/L starts, and the schedule produces exactly that many because every trail runs to the cap and no early abort exists on the production path.  (c) Each start is priced as a COLD two-scalar exponentiation y = g^a z^b (1525 full multiplies at 47924 Ir) that never reads the secret x: v36 priced G.start(g^a z^{xb}) at 7660 Ir and the fixture read x.
budget.starts_lower_bound: starts >= ceil(S/L) = 1461847968611600655368414726242031 (the inequality v36 had reversed)
budget.early_abort: removed from the production schedule: the fixture's stall-abort path is a measurement convenience and is NOT on the launched path (the run_one loop runs to the step budget and every trail to the cap), so the start count cannot exceed ceil(S/L)
budget.guard_split: DELETED: every step pays STEP12, frequency-independent

detection.mechanism: the shipped dict28_wide_lookup hit; both collision classes are accepted and each hit is one pair
detection.yield_source: evidence/arm37.json: ACTUAL collisions inside protocol37.run_one (the shipped path), counted by class, with the denominator and the recovered x checked per hit; the L=64 arm is the schedule control

census_fidelity.why: a census-scale store makes ACTUAL collisions frequent; the walk, the store code and the recovery are the shipped ones

store_spec_to_code.shipped_structure: h = ceil(128/22) = 6 radix levels; a node is 2^22 x 8 B = 32 MiB; every calloc argument is <= SIZE_MAX

parsed_constants.source: scripts/ir28/dict28.c: D28_DB, rd_new() calloc(2^db, 8), ws_node record = 96 B

occupancy.exponential_argument_magnitude: S/M = 7.380446e+04; e^-x < 2^-106473, so M(1-e^-x) exceeds M-1 by a margin larger than one node

dense_six_ceil_control.verdict: the dense-leaf formula understates the reached-node count by the printed ratio; it is flagged, not used

store_spec_to_code.init_row: reached nodes x 2^22 Ir; reached = ceil(M(1-e^(-S/M))), M = 2^110 -- NOT 6*ceil(S/(4*2^22))

arithmetic.loop_bound_rule: every six-limb loop runs at most 6 iterations, so 6 x the loop-free span upper-bounds the executed count of one call
arithmetic.executed_code: scripts/protocol37.Group.state and Group.step CALL these symbols through ctypes on EVERY step -- the priced code is the executed code (v36 priced four-limb helpers the fixture never called)

bounds_table.array: record node (96 B), one per records[] block of 40
bounds_table.note: SEPARATE constant from the radix node; v36 overwrote NODE_BYTES with the 32 MiB radix size

bounds_table.array: radix node (32 MiB), one calloc per REACHED node
bounds_table.note: 32 MiB <= SIZE_MAX: every allocation is addressable with 64-bit pointers; the 128-bit slot is consumed 22 bits per level over h=6 levels

bounds_table.array: page table (one 128-bit node id per allocated node)
bounds_table.note: the table is addressed by the same level structure recursively

claim.rule: minimal n with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W; exact integer test

success.rule: p_used = p5 x min(yield at L=64, yield at the shipped L), each a 95% CP lower bound over ACTUAL collisions; the debit uses the WORSE schedule
